tools.name: assess_fit
tools.description: Assess whether a prospective client is a good fit for human.marketing. Returns a fit score and rationale, recommended services, relevant case studies, and a suggested next step. For business prospects (ecommerce, local/franchise, general) — not job seekers.

company.description: A description of the company (industry, model, size).

goals.description: What the company is trying to achieve.

budget.description: Approximate budget or budget range, if known.

tools.name: get_blog_posts
tools.description: Search and list human.marketing blog articles (marketing thought leadership). Filter by topic or business type. Returns title, summary, link, author, publish date, and read time.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default 20).

slug.description: Return a single post by its slug.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: List human.marketing client case studies — real results from the agency's portfolio. Returns the title, summary, link, and image for each. Use to surface proof of work or find examples relevant to a prospect.

slug.description: Return a single case study by its slug, e.g. 'work/thompson-tee'.

limit.description: Maximum number of case studies to return (default 50).

tools.name: get_guided_journey
tools.description: Get a curated, persona-aware path through human.marketing — an ordered set of services, case studies, articles, and a contact step tailored to the visitor. Pass a persona, or a free-text description and it will infer one.

persona.description: The visitor type to tailor the journey to.

description.description: Free-text description of the visitor or company; used to infer the persona when one isn’t given.

limit.description: Max items to include per step (default 4).

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List the marketing services human.marketing offers (SEO, paid media, email, CRO, branding, social, SMS, and more). Returns the title, summary, and link for each service.

slug.description: Return a single service by its slug.

limit.description: Maximum number of services to return (default 50).

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: List human.marketing team members. Filter by role or name. Returns each person’s name, role, short bio, photo, and profile link.

slug.description: Return a single person by their slug.

limit.description: Maximum number of people to return (default 50).

tools.name: lead_capture
tools.description: Submit a prospective client's contact details to human.marketing's sales team, who will follow up directly. Only call this after the visitor has explicitly provided their own info and agreed to be contacted — do not invent or guess details on their behalf. Rate-limited to prevent abuse.

company.description: The name of the company the visitor represents.

budget.description: Approximate monthly marketing budget, if known.

goals.description: What the visitor is trying to achieve.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search across human.marketing pages and blog posts. Returns matching titles, summaries, and links.

scope.description: Limit results to pages, blog posts, or both.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20).
